clips.title: The story
paras: Crank Fizzlebub seeks an enterprising adventurer to gather Singing Crystal Shards from the basilisks of Stranglethorn Vale. Competition with the Venture Company prevents him from harvesting the mineral deposits directly, leaving basilisk hides as the next best option. He promises a cut of the profits to anyone willing to bring him ten decent specimens.

Crank Fizzlebub has identified an eager market for the Singing Crystals unique to Stranglethorn Vale. Unfortunately for his business ambitions, the aggressive presence of the Venture Company makes it hard for him to gather raw crystal in the field. To circumvent his rivals, Fizzlebub turns to an alternative method: basilisks consume the crystals, incorporating the mineral into their hardened hides, which allows usable shards to be retrieved from them instead.

While any basilisk in the jungle might yield acceptable crystal fragments, Fizzlebub says the gentler ones are found along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, up north. Gathering ten shards allows him to move forward with his buyers, after which his business concerns shift toward the operations of the Venture Company itself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn, and are very valuable to certain parties. I can move those crystals, but the cursed Venture Company makes it hard for an honest entrepreneur like myself to gather any!
The basilisks in Stranglethorn eat the crystal. This gives them their hardened skin, and sometimes decent quality crystal can be harvested from it.
You can get it from any basilisk, but the less nasty ones are along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, to the north.
